LanguageData.LP_OozeCore.label: ooze body
LanguageData.LP_OozeCore.description: The body is a thinking mass of protoplasm with no bones and no fixed organ positions. Blunt weapons just sink in, and acid can't dissolve it; wounds close up by themselves, never get infected or leave scars, and blood loss is slower than normal. Anyone with this gene counts as oozefolk.
LanguageData.LP_OozeCore.customEffectDescriptions.0: Counts as oozefolk (engulf, fission, stabilizing belt, race checks).
LanguageData.LP_OozeCore.customEffectDescriptions.1: Acid damage: ×25% (all damage whose name contains Acid, including acid from this mod and other mods).
LanguageData.LP_OozeCore.customEffectDescriptions.3: Wounds don't get infected, and old wounds never become permanent scars.
LanguageData.LP_OozeCore.customEffectDescriptions.4: Mind flayer tadpoles can't parasitize (they get dissolved).
LanguageData.LP_OozeProtoplasm.label: protoplasm
LanguageData.LP_OozeProtoplasm.description: Stores protoplasm in the body that can be drawn on at will. Provides the "protoplasm" resource bar (0-100, starting at 30, doesn't drain naturally): eating and engulfing corpses replenish it, and fission, seeping, reshaping and exuding gel all consume it.
LanguageData.LP_OozeProtoplasm.customEffectDescriptio: Max protoplasm 100 (120 with a stabilizing belt), starting at 30, doesn't drain naturally.
LanguageData.LP_OozeProtoplasm.resourceDescription: Protoplasm an oozefolk can draw on. Replenished by eating and engulfing corpses; consumed by fission, seeping, reshaping and exuding gel. Doesn't drain naturally.
LanguageData.LP_OozeDigest.label: omnivorous digestion
LanguageData.LP_OozeDigest.description: The stomach is the whole body. Can dissolve anything: no food poisoning, doesn't mind raw food; each meal also stores a little more protoplasm. Can "engulf" a whole corpse into the body to slowly digest it.
LanguageData.LP_OozeDigest.customEffectDescriptions.0: Not unhappy about eating raw food.
LanguageData.LP_OozePseudopod.label: pseudopod
LanguageData.LP_OozePseudopod.description: Can lash out an acid-dripping pseudopod from the body as a whip at any time, and clothes soaked in the acid wear out especially fast. Even without both hands it can work with pseudopods, so manipulation won't drop below 60%.
LanguageData.LP_OozePseudopod.customEffectDescription: Gains the "acid pseudopod" melee attack: 9 blunt + 4 acid, cooldown 2 seconds; acid damage to the victim's clothing ×200%.
Manipulation no lower than 60% (but not above consciousness).
LanguageData.LP_OozeAmorphous.label: amorphous
LanguageData.LP_OozeAmorphous.description: The body has no fixed shape and can squeeze through any gap: can "seep" through a door crack, even if it's locked or belongs to someone else. They also break out of prison more easily, and locked doors can't stop them during a break.
LanguageData.LP_OozeAmorphous.customEffectDescription: As a prisoner: prison break chance ×200% (multiplies with effects like criminal backstories); can open any door during a prison break.
LanguageData.LP_OozeSplit.label: fission reproduction
LanguageData.LP_OozeSplit.description: Oozefolk don't reproduce through pregnancy; instead, once enough protoplasm is stored, they split themselves in two: what splits off is a baby carrying all the parent's endogenes. The price is being unable to reproduce the ordinary way with anyone (including other oozefolk).
LanguageData.LP_OozeChill.label: congealed
LanguageData.LP_OozeChill.description: Protoplasm thickens in the cold. Oozefolk fear the cold: min comfortable temperature 8°C higher; standing somewhere below 0°C, the body "congeals", walking slowly with clumsy hands, recovering only 1 hour after warming up. Frostbite, the winter wolf's frost bite and the ice devil's chill are especially harmful to them.
LanguageData.LP_OozeChill.customEffectDescriptions.0: On a cell below 0°C (-15°C with a stabilizing belt): congealed, move speed ×75%, manipulation -10%; disappears 1 hour after warming up.
LanguageData.LP_OozeChill.customEffectDescriptions.1: Frostbite and other cold damage ×150%; frost slow, frostbound and chilled-to-the-bone durations ×150%.
LanguageData.LP_OozeDesiccate.label: fears drying out
LanguageData.LP_OozeDesiccate.description: Protoplasm is mostly water: it boils in fire and dries out when roasted: fire damage taken ×150%, and catches fire more easily.
LanguageData.LP_OozeSheen.label: flowing sheen
LanguageData.LP_OozeSheen.description: Oozefolk always have a wet sheen on top of the head, occasionally dripping a drop of gel. Purely cosmetic, colored after the skin.
LanguageData.LP_SkinOozeGreen.label: bile green skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinOozeGreen.description: The bile-green common to oozefolk, translucent with a wet gleam.
LanguageData.LP_SkinOozeBlue.label: abyssal blue skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinOozeAmber.label: amber skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinOozeAmber.description: Amber protoplasm like honey or resin.
LanguageData.LP_SkinOozeViolet.label: mist purple skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinOozeViolet.description: Grey-purple protoplasm with a misty layer.
